svg.title: Removing items while looping
svg.desc: Four rows show the list scan each time the for loop reads an item; the index read is drawn as a red cell and the column numbers 0 to 4 are at the top. Tag 1: 0.0, 0.0, 2.5, 0.0, 3.1 with index 0 (0.0) in red. Tag 2: 0.0, 2.5, 0.0, 3.1 with index 1 (2.5) in red. Tag 3: the same four values with index 2 (0.0) in red. Tag 4: 2.5, 0.0, 3.1 with an empty dashed red cell at index 3, past the end of the list.
